annotations.title: LGA · Leased rents by bedroom, Victorian councils

description:
Median weekly rent on new Victorian tenancies, and the number of new bonds, each quarter since 1999 by dwelling type and bedrooms (flats and houses), for every Victorian council area.

Coverage: All 79 Victorian council areas with at least 5 new bonds in the quarter and group; June quarter 1999 onwards. Current to 2026-06-30. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/leased-rents-vic`.

**Price: 10¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: rent_all, rent_flat_1bed, rent_flat_2bed, rent_flat_3bed, rent_house_2bed, rent_house_3bed, rent_house_4bed, bonds_all, bonds_flat_1bed, bonds_flat_2bed, bonds_flat_3bed, bonds_house_2bed, bonds_house_3bed, bonds_house_4bed. Omit for all.

lga_name.description: Council (LGA) name exactly as /v1/lga/list returns it, e.g. `Lake Macquarie`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
